meta.user_disclaimer: 模型结果可复现，部分关键假设仍待验证。

scenarios.label: A · 当前参数基准
scenarios.assumption: 原季初 Elo、τ=5、σ=14、原启发式委员会；未全面校准。

scenarios.label: B · 统一结转先验
scenarios.assumption: 采用 2025 年末 Elo 的 2/3 均值回归；对来源异常仍未最终定性。

scenarios.label: C · 更高的实力不确定性
scenarios.assumption: 每队每季的潜在实力标准差调为 7.5 分；历史样本未能唯一识别 τ。

scenarios.label: D · 履历导向委员会
scenarios.assumption: 相同比赛结果，委员会改为更重视赛季胜负与对手质量的排序；未优于原模型。

scenarios.label: E · 多假设组合压力测试
scenarios.short: 2024 冷启动 + τ=7.5 + 履历排序
scenarios.assumption: 多项欠训练/未充分验证假设组合。不可视为概率下限，不与其他情景等权。

ENGINEERING_REPRODUCIBLE.basis: All 5 x 20k traces independent checked for 382 regular and 11 CFP draws; end-to-end order inversion and keyed event tests; repeat legacy 10-path replay
ENGINEERING_REPRODUCIBLE.limitation: Snapshot file SHA values are code/data identity checks, not evidence of PIT or forecast validity

INPUT_PROVENANCE_VERIFIED.basis: Source file Drive ID, modified time and SHA established; IU 2064 tied to 2025 postseason 2346 and 2/3 mean regression
INPUT_PROVENANCE_VERIFIED.limitation: Retrospectively downloaded 2026 schedule at 19:39 EDT after 18:00 forecast as-of; 11 serious cross-year prior exceptions; no archived PIT source

GAME_MODEL_VALIDATED.basis: Per-game Brier and logloss by year, 2024/25 FBS/FCS + postseason, production marginal p evaluated
GAME_MODEL_VALIDATED.limitation: Only two touched test-year clusters; poor FCS, limited strong-game sample, off-season source not independent

LATENT_UNCERTAINTY_VALIDATED.basis: History midpoint residual wins CRPS and 80pct width/coverage evaluated for sigma x tau candidates
LATENT_UNCERTAINTY_VALIDATED.limitation: 2024/25 only and previously used; tau-sigma not independently identified; season-trajectory probability change huge

COMMITTEE_MODEL_VALIDATED.basis: 2024 11/12 and 2025 10/12 official field match for frozen heuristic; alternative 10/12 and 9/12
COMMITTEE_MODEL_VALIDATED.limitation: Two seasonal decision clusters only, no point-in-time ranking calibration; strong JMU false ranking

RULES_VERIFIED.basis: CFP 2026-27 official 12 school entry and first round byes verified as published Aug 6, 2026
RULES_VERIFIED.limitation: BigTen 2026 SportSource missing; other league tiebreaks approximated; some CCG venue rules not fully certified

official_sources.name: 2026–27 CFP 官方选拔规则公告

notes: 2024、2025 数据已在 V4.4 研究阶段使用，并非独立未触碰测试集。
FBS/FCS 与强队小样本仍有校准风险。
委员会历史只有两个现代赛季的最终决策，不能据此认定概率已校准。
